note: City of Eveleth campground on a wooded point in Ely Lake off County Road 132 (Miller Trunk Road), about 1.5 miles south of town, with a swimming beach, fishing pier and a pavilion with kitchen. Fifteen of the 50 sites are rented by the season. --Claude
summary: City page, 2024 rates, 2012 site specs and 2013 map read: 50 sites, all water + 20/30 A (16 with 50 A), no sewer (free dump), 10 drive-through; $30 tax included; May 1-Sep 30; reserve by phone from April 1. Long-stay passes (15 seasonal of 50, 5 monthly). Not waterfront kept (sites 24-27 ~40-50 m from Ely Lake through woods). Pin is on the highway ~260 m from the loops: move suggested.
flags: Pin: stored 47.43700,-92.50602 sits on County Road 132 (Miller Trunk Road) south-west of the campground, ~260 m from the camp loops. Google's address point for the campground is 47.43875,-92.50345. Suggest 47.4389,-92.5040 (between the shower building and the loops).

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. The campground occupies a wooded point in Ely Lake; on the 2013 map sites 24-27 are nearest the shore at the end of the loop by the lakeside parking area. On imagery the nearest camper pads are ~40-50 m from the water through continuous trees; the shore by the parking area is a rock wall and the swimming beach and fishing pier are day use. No site is on open ground at the water, and no source shows the lake from a site.

Long-stay check (passes): 2024 rates post nightly $30, weekly $200, monthly '(Limit 5) $600/Month' and 'Limited seasonal sites (15) available' at $2000 for May 1-Sep 30 = 15 of 50 sites (30%) seasonal. No wording discouraging nightly guests. Local campground, no price gate.
Hookups and sites rest on the city's 2012 per-site spec sheet, still linked from the campground page; it is the only per-site source.
Fees: 2024 rate sheet is the latest posted; the reservation policy page still says 'currently $30'.
